comment: Dr. Cook is extremely nice. He drives up from NC once a week to teach this class. There are five take-home tests that are very difficult, but he offers full corrections. The class environment is very relaxed, as he likes to make jokes. I didn't learn much from that class. You also get out after an hour at most, even though it's supposed to be three

If you're at all insecure about taking Econ, don't take Professor Cook. He doesn't have office hours and he's  unhelpful via email. His take home quizzes are fine half the time or you have to take 20 years to figure out what he's trying to ask you. His grading scale is wonky too (can only get whole letter grades, a 90 is a B, etc.).

Prof. Cook drives up once a week from NC to teach the class. It's supposed to last for 3 hours but you ALWAYS get out super early.  The grading is based on Problem sets which are due every week. These problem sets can be a little tricky but he allows you to do corrections and drops the worst one of the semester.  Love him

Professor lives in North Carolina, He only comes up for a couple hours a week. No office hours. Quizzes are tricky and he tries to trick people. Explanations of topics are crystal clear in class, but when you take the quizzes you will feel like you haven't see the topic before.

classes are okay and he tries to keep them going so its not so boring. if you arent great in the subject then the lectures will make sense but when you try to do the tests you will be lost. hes tricky but swears hes not. good luck.
Great professor but a little ambiguous on tests and quizzes. Likes to be tricky.
yeah hes a little weird and wears the same tie everyday and picks a student in the class to tell him when it annoys them
He's an okay teacher. His lectures can be kind of redundant, and all of his tests are take-home! They are pretty tricky but overall not too bad. Grading scale is weird tho(considers a 90=B!)
His class was like milk, it was good for 2 weeks.
Class was really easy.  Had mono though and missed class a bunch so he took it out on my grade.  Watch out for his grading scale (got a 90 and was still given a b)
likes to surprise students with his take home tests... they aint easy...most questions dont have correct answers.... makes you think on a different level... overall not bad

Easiest Econ class i have ever taken at UR. He is very clear and makes sure those who have not taken econ before don't get lost. Very helpful in his office hours too. You should not miss class though. All the material in his take homes come (straight) from class notes.

A nice man, but a poor professor. His take-home tests are horrible - they don't cover what he teaches in class. So far, all of his tests have had errors in them, so you will spend hours on a problem only to discover that it can't be solved. Save yourself the headache and don't sign up for his class.
